name: com.vixencreations.vixens-toolbox
description: A suite of Unity Editor tools for VRChat creators, hand-built by VixForge Interactive. Four flagship tools lead it: a non-destructive Quest Conversion Engine, a full Avatar Optimization Suite with real QEM mesh decimation, a multi-ecosystem World Engine auditor (ProTV, AudioLink, LTCGI, VRSL, Light Volumes and more), and Animation Workbench Pro. Also includes Animator Forge, PhysBone blueprints, an Accessory Mounting Engine and a convention Badge Studio. Engineered to eliminate human error, enforce project consistency, and push Unity 2022.3 to its limits.
